2608.28557.title: Blog: Survey of Optimizers
2608.28557.paper_summary: Neural-network optimization in 2025-2026 is no longer well described as a succession of new Adam variants. The design space has expanded from coordinates to matrices and layers, from fixed training horizons to policies over time, and from mathematical update rules to state representations that must survive sharding and low-precision computation. This survey organizes recent optimizers and training optimization methods along four largely independent axes: temporal estimation, update geometry, horizon management, and representation and systems. It connects the spectral normalization of Muon, the historical matrix statistics of Shampoo and SOAP, adaptive and hybrid matrix methods, memory-efficient optimizers, schedule-free training, small-batch corrections, and quantized optimizer states. The central empirical conclusion is deliberately non-triumphal: matrix-aware methods represent a genuine advance, but there is no context-independent replacement for AdamW. Rankings change with model scale, data-to-parameter ratio, batch size, schedule, parameter partition, tuning budget, and whether the target metric is tokens, FLOPs, wall-clock time, or memory. The practical consequence is a compositional view of optimizer design and a stricter protocol for evaluating optimizer claims.
2608.28557.paper_summary_zh: 神經網絡優化在2025-2026年不再僅僅被描述為一系列新的Adam變體。設計空間已經從坐標擴展到矩陣和層，從固定的訓練範圍擴展到隨時間變化的策略，並且從數學更新規則擴展到必須在分片和低精度計算中生存的狀態表示。這項調查沿著四個大致獨立的軸組織了最近的優化器和訓練優化方法：時間估計、更新幾何、範圍管理，以及表示和系統。它將Muon的光譜正則化、Shampoo和SOAP的歷史矩陣統計、自適應和混合矩陣方法、內存高效的優化器、無排程訓練、小批量修正和量化優化器狀態聯繫在一起。中心的實證結論故意不帶勝利的語氣：矩陣感知方法代表了一種真正的進步，但沒有上下文獨立的AdamW替代品。排名隨著模型規模、數據與參數比率、批量大小、排程、參數劃分、調整預算，以及目標指標是令牌、FLOPs、牆鐘時間還是內存而變化。實際的後果是對優化器設計的組合視角，以及對評估優化器聲明的更嚴格協議。
2608.28557.author: Ruoran Xu et.al.
